topic: Clean lint out of a dryer vent
core_question: How do I clean lint buildup out of my dryer vent duct? (secondary: How do I get leather dress shoes shiny again after they've gone dull and scuffed?)
answer_summary: Disconnect the vent duct at the dryer and exterior exit, then run a flexible vent cleaning brush kit through the full length of the ductwork to pull out built-up lint.; after the topic shift: Clean the leather, apply a thin coat of matching shoe polish/wax with a cloth, let it dry briefly, then buff vigorously with a horsehair brush and a soft cloth for the final shine.
